description: This file defines a React component 'TasksList' that displays a list of tasks for the signed-in user. It fetches tasks from a backend service, allows creating new tasks, updating their status, and deleting them. It interacts with external services like 'tasksService' and checks if the backend is configured via 'supabaseClient'.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads tasks from the backend service, handles errors and loading state.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new task when the form is submitted.

methods.name: onUpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a given task, with optimistic UI update and error handling.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a task with optimistic UI update and error recovery.
